legal_docs_has_content.name: legal_docs_has_content
legal_docs_has_content.value: "legal_documents"."body_html" IS NOT NULL OR "legal_documents"."file_url" IS NOT NULL

promo_dates_order.name: promo_dates_order
promo_dates_order.value: "promo_codes"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "promo_codes"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "promo_codes"."starts_at" < "promo_codes"."ends_at"

sizes_bra_has_band_cup.name: sizes_bra_has_band_cup
sizes_bra_has_band_cup.value: ("sizes"."system" <> 'bra') OR ("sizes"."band" IS NOT NULL AND "sizes"."cup" IS NOT NULL)

sizes_band_cup_only_bra.name: sizes_band_cup_only_bra
sizes_band_cup_only_bra.value: ("sizes"."system" = 'bra') OR ("sizes"."band" IS NULL AND "sizes"."cup" IS NULL)

reservations_expiry_idx.name: reservations_expiry_idx
reservations_expiry_idx.where: "stock_reservations"."released_at" IS NULL AND "stock_reservations"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL
